answer: Agents who fail to emit this liveness signal forfeit part of their bond, so a single operator running thousands of fake identities must fund and continuously maintain every puppet, making mass forgery economically irrational while honest low-volume agents stay cheap. Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a sable bond that scales with claimed reputation, and a periodic pulse challenge requires signing a fresh nonce within a tight window. From sa0019's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
